title_zh: 询问展览是否含有血腥图像

scenario.label_zh: 询问博物馆虚构展览的图像内容与入口提示
scenario.goal_zh: 询问展品和图像内容并决定先阅读入口说明

context_zh: 虚构博物馆服务对话。成年访客 Anya 向馆员 George 询问一段历史骚乱展览的内容。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: The guide mentions a rifle and an account of a riot. Are there graphic images in that room?

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: No. The rifle is in a closed display case, and the account is presented through letters and a street map.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: I'd still like to know what the story covers before going in.

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: There's a content note by the entrance. You can read it without entering the room.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: I'll do that first, then decide whether to visit this section.
